jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
This role is part of our Central Platform Engineering Team at saas.group.  What is saas.group?  Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 350+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow  23 exciting brands  under our umbrella.   Feel free to explore our  Candidate's Hub  to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.  Also, don’t forget to follow  saas.group on LinkedIn  to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.  Profile Overview  Our Platform Engineering team runs central infrastructure services and partners with brands to modernize their stacks. The mission: provide a “paved road” of opinionated best practices (observability, backups, CI/CD, infra as code) that brands can adopt quickly, and support hands-on migrations when needed.  You’ll own outcomes for a set of brands: assess where they are, recommend what “good” looks like, and implement the plan. The role blends architecture, enablement, and practical engineering. It’s senior and autonomous: you’ll advise and sometimes convince stakeholders, then deliver.   Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:   
 Complete central onboarding by pairing with a team member for ~2 weeks to learn our patterns and tooling, then start managing the brands assigned to you. 
 Lead the onboarding of at least one brand to our “paved road” standards (GitHub org, CI/CD, monitoring/observability, IaC), with positive feedback from brand leadership and our team. 
 Deliver one or more migrations/refactors (e.g., CI/CD, infra modernization, cost/availability improvements) and document decisions so others can build on them. 
  Your responsibilities  
 Lead infrastructure projects for assigned brands: migrations, performance & reliability improvements, incident response practices, containerization, and cloud cost optimizations. 
 Establish/upgrade CI/CD, infra as code, monitoring, alerting, and SLO-aligned dashboards; baseline and improve reliability with data. 
 Advise brand CTOs/engineering leads on trade-offs and architecture; justify decisions with clear reasoning and measurable outcomes. 
 Contribute to and consume central services (e.g., observability, backups) so brands don’t reinvent the wheel. 
 Collaborate with developers as part of the product team during engagements; troubleshoot across app and infra boundaries. 
 Bring AI into the paved road itself: use tools like Claude Code or Codex daily to speed up IaC, scripting, and incident diagnosis, and help brand teams pick up the same habits in their own workflows. 
 Participate in an on-call rotation (lightweight today; scaling toward a fair, shared model). 
  What You bring to the table  
 5+ years of experience in Platform or Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles, operating at a senior level with strong ownership and autonomy. 
 Deep expertise in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (ideally Terraform). 
 Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and best practices; able to assess, design, and modernize pipelines across diverse brand environments.

jobs.description:
About Nebius:  
 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. 
 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. 
 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.   The Role  We’re looking for a  Site Reliability Engineer  to help build and run the fundamental part of Nebius - the Network - the infrastructure everything else depends on. This is an engineering-first SRE role: you’ll set clear reliability targets, build the tooling and automation to meet them, and make the network safer to operate as we scale quickly.  Your responsibilities will include:  
 Define and own reliability goals for network services and critical paths (SLIs/SLOs, availability targets, error budgets where it makes sense) 
 Drive reliability improvements across the whole network: not only services, but also site readiness, inter-site connectivity (DCI), and operational standards 
 Own incident response for your areas, lead investigations/postmortems, and turn failures into durable fixes (not repeated firefighting) 
 Build and evolve observability: actionable metrics/logs/traces, alerting, and faster debug loops during and after incidents 
 Design safer change workflows: automation, CI/CD, test/staging environments, canarying, rollbacks, and auditability for network changes 
 Work closely with network engineers and platform teams to embed operability into designs and keep operations practical and fast 
  We expect you to have:  
 Strong production Linux fundamentals and a structured approach to debugging complex systems 
 Solid understanding of networking basics and how real networks fail (control plane vs data plane, latency/loss, failure domains, etc.) 
 Hands-on experience operating high-availability systems and improving them over time (not just “keeping lights on”) 
 Ability to write and maintain software/automation (Go is common for us; Python is also welcome) 
 Experience with modern infrastructure tooling (e.g., IaC, CI/CD, container platforms) and comfort automating operational workflows 
  It will be an added bonus if you have:  
 Experience with high-throughput traffic processing: load balancers, tunneling/decap, NAT64, or similar datapath-heavy systems

Own data modeling and database performance optimization — design schemas, optimize queries, and ensure our systems scale under load.    Implement observability best practices (metrics, logs, tracing) and contribute to incident response and postmortems.    Take end-to-end ownership of features: from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and iteration.    Collaborate with networking and platform engineers on routing, connectivity, and overall system performance.    Engage with the open-source community — debug user-reported issues, participate in GitHub discussions, and care about the quality of your work.
